notes: THE ONE FILE TO EDIT for local Ollama models. test-console/switch-models.ps1 -To ollama (use-ollama.cmd) reads it and generates config/generated/ (catalog, scores, Ollama Modelfiles); never edit the generated files. Each model gets `defaults` unless it overrides a value. numCtx is the context Ollama loads for that model (a per-model variant is created with `ollama create`, so no global OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH is needed) and the context the gateway plans with; it is capped at the model's trained maximum. maxOutputTokens is the budget for thinking + answer. Keep maxOutputTokens the same for every model: the gateway's --max-output-tokens is set to the smallest one, and a request asks for that much. quality/tasks/speed rank the models when a request names none; defaultModel always ranks first and is the UI pick list's default. GPU memory (8 GB on the RTX 3070 Ti) bounds numCtx: check `ollama ps` shows 100% GPU after a model loads.
